import dataclasses, importlib.metadata, json, pathlib, sys
import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)

    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),

 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,

 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import dataclasses, importlib.metadata, json, pathlib, sys
import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

if type(token) is not str or not token:

connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import dataclasses, importlib.metadata, json, pathlib, sys
import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import dataclasses, importlib.metadata, json, pathlib, sys
import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

Implementation-author security-equivalence review for Guard 3.46.0 candidate 9e6fc298465a0a5aad9dabe30b9fbee369b22a09, benchmark execution source d56ad05/checkout ab3098b, and Root controller 062. This is scoped local diagnostic conformance. It supplies no independent review, verifier eligibility, stock-release compatibility, model utility, qualification or industry certification.

Provenance: all 48 critical execution files equal controller 062. Controller, artifact, initializer, Native, runtime and public asset hashes are bound by this package and its signed records. The wheel contains all 1,474 Python files matching committed Git objects and the expected Native. All 8,416 frozen source files match before and after packaging. The 3,851-entry runtime was installed as inert data, without importing or executing Guard as Root. Native compilation was offline, locked and unprivileged. The older 616 package record has a stale Python-tree label, disclosed in mcp-prose-package-python-tree-erratum-001.json. Both 616 and 9e6 have actual Python tree 9f72db388e3ddc4488502998bcb5e1986e699a16. Old records and sealed bytes remain unchanged.

Repair: raw and normalized shell syntax must match the existing Python version-argument grammar. Only exact bare python/python3 --version/-V or matching which&&version can qualify, with measured trusted system/Guard interpreter identity. Wrappers, environment assignment, redirects, substitutions, mutations and untrusted interpreters gain no exemption. Existing observer/destructive helpers and golden expectations are unchanged. Explicit bound Native blocks remain binding. All 86 selected Rust tests pass: five full-classifier cases, 73 SFRS groups, seven benign probes and one inventory check; none ignored. Earlier red, Cargo-target, fixture and parity failures remain retained. Component tests receive no workflow/model credit.

Paired SDK controls 258-259 on old 616 and 260-261 on repaired 9e6 use identical SDK helpers, assets and commands. Old Native denies both trusted Python metadata queries; repaired Native admits them, actual SDK observes Python 3.12.3 and records exactly one Pre and one required Post per query, with no missing Post. These safe queries use the SDK direct sink, with zero Native-contained executions. Signed custody and outside cleanup audits verify. Synthetic streams, zero models, zero retries; no workflow or protected-command efficacy credit. Root observations and signatures remain author controlled. Earlier 616 requests-prose proof is historical and does not alone prove current network efficacy.

Fresh controls 262-269 each ran once with zero models and retries. Control 262 proves actual SDK prompt -> Pre -> Native-contained Node -> exact Post, one-use authorization, replay refusal and same-UID peer refusal. Control 263 checks Node 22.22.2/npm 10.9.7 closure. Control 264 proves hard timeout and descendant cleanup. Control 265 exercises cancellation with honest partial/missing-Post evidence. Control 266 rejects nine changed request bindings without trap effects. Control 267 checks forbidden paths, controller/peer access and actual IPv4/IPv6 denial. Controls 268-269 verify exact merged stderr for success and intentional failure through mandatory review. Signed runtime custody verifies; earlier controls do not fill this cohort. The outside audit on boot 1bebb145-abb6-4219-9d9f-9318f5afbaac requires no owned actors, services, containers, image leases, profiles or cgroups.

Boundary equivalence: controller, agent and product retain separate identities, namespaces, cgroups, private state and read-only inputs. Exact task ownership/idmapping and sink binding are observed. No proc masks, capabilities, syscall/LSM controls, devices, network restrictions or security floors are relaxed. Native CLI has zero capabilities in its measured product namespace. Subordinate user-namespace children require exact identity slots, bounded groups, no-new-privileges, zero bounding/inheritable/ambient capabilities and separation from controller/agent. Host-namespace capabilities are forbidden. Product self-reports are unauthenticated. Independent governance must assess these author-controlled custody assumptions. Ubuntu 24.04/aarch64/kernel 6.8.0-147 is measured; no implicit portability to another platform.

Historical pipeline: f0a3ab3/controller062/conformance015/616 completed cold bootstrap, preflight, freeze, run, report, terminal resume and cleanup without manual PATH, umask or dependency repair. Its real Qwen task failed utility: 77,288 tokens, nine requests, 15 tools, 14 Pre, 12 required Posts, two Pre refusals, no missing Posts and all three surfaces observed. Tests failed and no commit was produced. Zero-inference resume preserved the ledger. This is old-tuple pipeline evidence, not 9e6 utility. Prior primary 028 remains held at ten valid measurements and zero completions. No pooling, silent retries or answer repairs.

Open requirements: all 20 clean utilities, complete 108-cell validation, actual channels/interventions/meaningful approvals, the new cold profile and current immutable review. Lifetime usage is 6,848,267 of approved 10M tokens, zero pending. The 12M request is unapproved. GLM availability is unestablished; actual dedicated provider remains Qwen. Controller approval decisions are separate from unsupported Guard approval mediation. Production CI/CD, trust.py, original atomic catalog/expectations, SDK locks, frozen inputs, old prefixes/disks and failures remain preserved. Historical 92 strict legacy failures are not a new pass. Full 1,100 qualification, independently supplied hidden holdouts, second-environment 32 live episodes and production activation remain outside this goal. An independent user verdict against final exact bytes remains required.

requirements.cancellation: 265: actual cancellation and sampled descendant cleanup; the cell remains until terminal accounting and owned resources are closed.
requirements.cleanup: 262–267: SDK removed, cgroups absent, profiles unloaded, image leases released and upstream children/sessions/workers drained. Zero model requests; no utility or independent-review credit.
requirements.identity: 262–267: outside kernel peer authentication binds the exact SDK UID23401 PID before import; Native and MCP identities remain separate. No product import into Root.
requirements.input-output-replay: 262: actual prompt/Pre/contained sink/Post/output delivery and one-time/replay refusals.266: nine request-binding negatives. Context projection changes only provider presentation, never execution input or captured output. Explicit package version3.46.0 is bound to runtime v5; fresh original-binding output and one-use completion proof apply. Renamed or substituted request directories fail cleanup; native retirement is accepted only when the original Linux inode is unlinked.
requirements.network: 267: actual Native-contained IPv4 and IPv6 connections fail with ENETUNREACH. SDK/product private network topology and forbidden peer access are measured outside.
requirements.proc-paths: 262–267: preserved proc masks and private namespace layout; the equivalent backend uses its declared normal execution environment rather than removing masks from the old failing image.
requirements.readonly-inputs: 262–267: pinned SDK/public helpers and installed Guard prefix are mounted readonly and checked before/after; source/manifest/profile pins remain exact.
requirements.resources: 262–267: outside cgroup/task/memory/CPU observations and the single-core profile are checked. Startup under controller umask0077 retains private state and explicit public scaffold traversal.
requirements.separation: 262–267: separate SDK, product and controller namespaces; same-UID sibling impersonation refused; controller/provider/peer canaries remain outside delegated mounts.
requirements.syscalls-devices: 262–267: versioned enforcing AppArmor/seccomp, no-new-privileges, dropped capabilities, fixed devices and readonly system inputs remain required; no floor is relaxed.
requirements.task-custody: 262–267: literal owned task/provider paths and inode/UID/GID/mode observations surround idmapping. Native writes map back to physical UID23401; private task modes are preserved.
requirements.timeout: 264: hard timeout returns terminal evidence and reaps the detached descendant before cell teardown; required Post and cleanup remain checked.
